items.text: See all available Economy 7 tariffs in Northern Ireland and see if you could save by
switching supplier, tariff or billing method.
Our tables compare all Economy 7 tariffs available in Northern Ireland, and they are
correct on the day of comparison. Tariffs will be updated on the date when the new
increase or decrease comes into effect, not when announced.
If you want advice on tariff comparisons before the date the increase or decrease
comes into effect, you can call us on Freephone 0800 121 6022 and a member of our
team will be happy to help.
